standard: IEC 62443-4-2 Security for industrial automation and control systems — Part 4-2: Technical security requirements for IACS components

clauses.title: Human user identification and authentication
clauses.body: Components shall provide the capability to identify and authenticate all human users. The authentication mechanism shall enforce commonly accepted security practices for password strength, storage, and lifetime.

clauses.title: Authenticator management
clauses.body: Components shall provide the capability to change all default authenticators upon installation, and to change authenticators subsequently on demand. Default credentials shall not be used in the deployed configuration.

clauses.title: Software and information integrity
clauses.body: Components shall provide the capability to detect, record, report, and respond to unauthorized changes to software and configuration. Cryptographic mechanisms shall be used where feasible.

clauses.title: Support for updates
clauses.body: Components shall provide the capability to update software and firmware. Update mechanisms shall verify the authenticity and integrity of the update prior to installation using cryptographic mechanisms.

clauses.title: Information confidentiality
clauses.body: Components shall provide the capability to protect the confidentiality of information at rest and in transit using cryptographic mechanisms appropriate to the sensitivity of the information.

clauses.title: Use of cryptography
clauses.body: When cryptographic mechanisms are used, the component shall use algorithms, key lengths, and modes of operation that follow current, generally accepted good security practice.
